import math
import time


def primes_up_to(limit):
    t0 = time.process_time_ns()
    is_prime = bytearray(b"\x01") * (limit + 1)
    is_prime[:2] = b"\x00\x00"
    t1 = time.process_time_ns()
    for candidate in range(2, math.isqrt(limit) + 1):
        if is_prime[candidate]:
            start = candidate * candidate
            is_prime[start::candidate] = bytes((limit - start) // candidate + 1)
    t2 = time.process_time_ns()
    result = is_prime.count(1)
    t3 = time.process_time_ns()
    return t1-t0, t2-t1, t3-t2, result


totals = [0,0,0]
result = 0
for repetition in range(300):
    phases = primes_up_to(20000)
    for i in range(3):
        totals[i] += phases[i]
    result += phases[3]
print(result)
print(*totals, sep='\n')

import math
import time


def primes_up_to(limit):
    t0 = time.process_time_ns()
    is_prime = [True] * (limit + 1)
    is_prime[:2] = [False, False]
    t1 = time.process_time_ns()
    for candidate in range(2, math.isqrt(limit) + 1):
        if is_prime[candidate]:
            start = candidate * candidate
            is_prime[start::candidate] = [False] * ((limit - start) // candidate + 1)
    t2 = time.process_time_ns()
    result = is_prime.count(True)
    t3 = time.process_time_ns()
    return t1-t0, t2-t1, t3-t2, result


totals = [0,0,0]
result = 0
for repetition in range(300):
    phases = primes_up_to(20000)
    for i in range(3):
        totals[i] += phases[i]
    result += phases[3]
print(result)
print(*totals, sep='\n')
